resources.string: UnreDo shows a small Undo / Redo toolbar right above your keyboard, no matter which keyboard app you use. It works entirely through Android\'s Accessibility service — no root, no ADB, no Shizuku required.
Accessibility service is enabled. The toolbar will appear above your keyboard.
Accessibility service is not enabled yet.
Detects the active on-screen keyboard and shows a small floating Undo/Redo toolbar above it. Does not read, store, or transmit personal data.
